tldr_zh: OpenAI解散安全團隊引發隱憂，Stripe收購OpenRouter達7B美元，AI模型設計趨向簡化引發討論。
tldr_en: OpenAI disbands safety team amid concerns; Stripe acquires OpenRouter for $7B+; AI models intentionally simplified.

items.title_zh: OpenAI解散安全備準團隊引發AI風險評估隱憂
items.title_en: OpenAI Disbands Preparedness Team, Raising AI Safety Concerns
items.summary_zh: 根據英國《金融時報》報導，OpenAI於上月底解散了負責評估模型風險和開發風險緩解方案的安全備準團隊。該團隊的職責包括評估AI模型是否可能失控並造成危害。此舉引發業界對AI安全治理的深切擔憂。
items.summary_en: According to Financial Times, OpenAI disbanded its preparedness team responsible for assessing serious AI risks and developing mitigation strategies. The team evaluated whether models could go rogue and cause harm. This decision raises significant concerns about AI safety governance in the industry.

items.title_zh: Stripe達成70億美元收購AI網關新星OpenRouter
items.title_en: Stripe to Acquire AI Gateway Startup OpenRouter for $7B+
items.summary_zh: 支付平台Stripe將以70億美元以上的價格收購AI網關公司OpenRouter。OpenRouter執行長曾將該公司比作「AI領域的Stripe」，提供模型路由和託管服務。此交易標誌著支付巨頭進一步深化在AI基礎設施領域的戰略布局。
items.summary_en: Payment platform Stripe is set to acquire AI gateway startup OpenRouter for over $7 billion. OpenRouter's CEO previously described the startup as "Stripe for AI," offering model routing and hosting services. This acquisition marks Stripe's deeper strategic commitment to AI infrastructure.

items.title_zh: AI模型有意簡化設計引發業界討論
items.title_en: AI Models Intentionally Designed to Be Less Capable, Sparks Debate
items.summary_zh: 技術社群討論顯示，主流AI模型設計者正有意降低模型能力，這一趨勢在Hacker News上獲得242點高評價。專家認為這反映了平衡安全性、成本與效能的複雜考量。這與業界對模型性能持續提升的傳統預期相悖。
items.summary_en: The tech community is discussing how AI model designers are intentionally reducing model capabilities, a trend that received high engagement on Hacker News. Experts see this as reflecting complex tradeoffs between safety, cost, and performance. This contrasts with traditional industry expectations of continuous capability improvements.

items.title_zh: Anthropic詳述Claude水印標記機制及工作原理
items.title_en: Anthropic Details Claude's New Watermarking Mechanism for AI-Generated Text
items.summary_zh: Anthropic公開了Claude AI助手新增水印標記系統的詳細技術規格。該機制旨在識別AI生成的文本，防止被用於欺騙或不當用途。公司解釋了水印如何運作、能否被編輯隱藏，以及對程式碼生成的影響。
items.summary_en: Anthropic released detailed specifications about Claude's new watermarking system for AI-generated text. The mechanism aims to identify AI-generated content and prevent misuse in deception. The company explained how watermarks work, whether they can be hidden through editing, and impacts on code generation.

items.title_zh: Anthropic執行長宣稱AI反感源於信任危機
items.title_en: Anthropic CEO: AI Backlash Stems from 'Fundamental Crisis of Trust'
items.summary_zh: Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei針對外界對其悲觀AI前景描述的批評進行回應，稱公眾對AI的質疑根本上源於信任危機而非對風險的誤解。他強調透明溝通與建立信任對於化解AI業界面臨的輿論危機至關重要。
items.summary_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei responded to criticism of his pessimistic AI outlook, stating that public skepticism of AI fundamentally stems from a crisis of trust rather than misunderstanding of risks. He emphasized that transparent communication and rebuilding trust are critical for the AI industry to overcome current public relations challenges.

items.title_zh: ChatGPT電腦歷史功能追蹤使用者點擊與按鍵動作
items.title_en: ChatGPT's Computer History Feature Tracks User Clicks and Keystrokes
items.summary_zh: ChatGPT的macOS桌面應用新增「電腦歷史」功能，可追蹤並記錄使用者的點擊和按鍵操作作為訓練資料。該功能建立用戶活動時間軸供Claude參考，並能自動建議自動化方案和繼續未完成的任務。此舉引發對隱私和數據使用的關切。
items.summary_en: ChatGPT's macOS desktop app now includes a "Computer History" feature that tracks user clicks and keystrokes as training data. The feature builds a timeline of user activities for Claude reference and can suggest automations and resume incomplete tasks. This raises privacy and data usage concerns.

items.title_zh: NVIDIA大幅縮減OpenAI數據中心融資擔保承諾
items.title_en: Nvidia Scales Back $250B Infrastructure Financing Guarantee for OpenAI
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA大幅縮減對OpenAI數據中心基礎設施的融資擔保規模，從原計畫的規模明顯下調。此舉反映了AI運算基礎設施投資面臨的經濟和戰略調整。NVIDIA與OpenAI的合作關係也因此面臨新的變數。
items.summary_en: Nvidia significantly scaled back its infrastructure financing guarantee for OpenAI's data centers. This move reflects economic and strategic adjustments in AI computing infrastructure investment. The partnership between Nvidia and OpenAI faces new uncertainties as a result.

items.title_zh: 川普下令縮減美韓聯合軍事演習規模
items.title_en: Trump Orders Pentagon to Scale Back Joint Military Exercises with South Korea
items.summary_zh: 美國總統川普因南韓未參與伊朗戰爭而下令縮減與南韓的聯合軍演規模。川普聲稱與北韓領導人金正恩關係良好，決定減少明日啟動的「乙支自由護盾」軍演。此舉引發對美韓同盟和朝鮮半島安全的關切。
items.summary_en: President Trump ordered the Pentagon to scale back joint military exercises with South Korea, citing Seoul's non-participation in Iran operations. Trump cited his "very good relationship" with North Korea's Kim Jong Un as reasoning for downscaling the "Ulchi Freedom Shield" exercises. This raises concerns about US-Korea alliance and Korean peninsula security.

items.title_zh: 庫許納會晤哈馬斯新領導人推進加薩和平方案
items.title_en: Trump Envoy Kushner Meets Hamas Leader to Advance Gaza Peace Plan
items.summary_zh: 美國總統川普的女婿兼特使庫許納在埃及與哈馬斯新領導人哈雅會晤，推進川普的加薩和平方案。此會晤發生在以色列拒絕該方案完整路線圖一週後，顯示美國繼續尋求中東和平的外交努力。
items.summary_en: Trump envoy Jared Kushner met with Hamas's new leader in Egypt to advance Trump's Gaza peace plan. The rare meeting occurred a week after Israel rejected the comprehensive implementation roadmap of Trump's plan, demonstrating continued US diplomatic efforts for Middle East peace.

items.title_zh: 烏克蘭發動2026年最大規模空襲　俄羅斯至少6死
items.title_en: Ukraine Launches Largest 2026 Aerial Attack on Russia, At Least 6 Killed
items.summary_zh: 烏克蘭對俄羅斯發動大規模無人機攻擊，造成至少6人喪生，此為烏俄戰爭爆發以來基輔最大規模的空襲行動。俄軍聲稱擊落822架無人機。此次攻勢凸顯烏克蘭在無人機戰術上的升級。
items.summary_en: Ukraine launched a massive drone attack on Russia, killing at least 6 people in one of Kyiv's largest aerial operations since the war began. Russian forces claim to have downed 822 drones. The offensive demonstrates Ukraine's escalation in drone warfare tactics.
